author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had a tiny r2 dotted head floating off the torso axis, a diagonal torso that could not certify the head gap, and a stiff two-segment stride. Now an r5 head sits over a vertical neck (exact 8-unit gap), and the torso leans forward to a set-back hip. The front arm tucks into the football, the back arm swings bent, the front knee is bent and the back leg kicks up: a running ball carrier as in the reference.
omissions: Outline (filled-body) construction replaced by the stick-figure vocabulary; the football seam.
